quote: As part of this strategy, Aggreko announced a US$216 million capital investment for Latin America in 2026, a 249% increase compared to 2025. … In this project, 24 communities in the state of Amazonas will have their systems hybridized, with the planned installation of 88 MWp in photovoltaic solar generation and 105 MWh in battery energy storage systems (BESS).
note: Opened Canal Solar English 2026-10-04 quoting Aggreko LatAm CEO; BNamericas 28 Jan 2026 corroborates figure (paywalled).
